I/.text:
1. Say Remixing before you work on your remix.
2. Duplicate the TEMP sprite and replace it with your character!
2A. Replace the costumes and the Voices. (Your character can also have different reactions from placements, you don't always have to follow the text in the templates.)
3. Don't be oversized, try to scale it with the size variable.
4. After you have finished the character, update the project name. (Don't add characters to the thumbnail.)
5. You can also add your music. (Not Recommended, There's enough Music already...)

The core of the Results code is in the "Podiums" sprite.
